svg.title: ValthvnQuota — Codex and Antigravity quota monitoring
svg.desc: Unaltered screenshots of the Windows taskbar widget and Antigravity quota flyout, taken from the public project repository. Screenshot numbers are captured examples, not the current profile owner quota. Fork of CodexQuota, extended with Antigravity support.
svg.text: Your AI tools, at a glance.
where you already look: the taskbar.
